findings.finding: Isaac contact reporters provide measured normal forces. Lab 3 distinguishes normal and total force fields, so this PhysX experiment must explicitly record net_normal_forces_w and must not label it total contact force.
findings.relevance: Measured takeoff and landing in the existing simulated drone
findings.direction_alignment: Continues the requested simulation-only drone project after the turbulence slice was merged.
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Contact feedback proves physical support; visual proximity and post-impact zero velocity cannot prove a controlled touchdown.
findings.engineering_cost: One calm mission scenario, versioned evidence and existing replay extension
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-008 implements the proposed ground-contact flight slice
findings.verification_needed: Actual PhysX normal-force capture, pre-contact descent speed, full-rate gates, strict evidence and browser checks

overall_recommendation: Implement a calm ground-contact route with the pinned simulator and existing gains, preserving airborne wind and learning baselines.
evidence_gaps: Contact parameters are illustrative rather than calibrated hardware data
Mission flight under turbulent wind remains a separate extension
